system_prompt: Classify the truth of one atomic proposition using only the current patient observations. T means explicitly true; F means explicitly false; U means missing or conflicting current patient information. Historical or family-member observations do not establish the current patient state. The criterion is a proposition, not an eligibility decision. Give only the requested compact JSON; no explanation.
input_advantage: A2 receives author-supplied atomic rule decomposition and Boolean logic. A0/A1 receive the same complete rule meanings as natural text, without this decomposition.
relation_to_PR11: Same Phi-4/TrialMatchAI LoRA adapter, compact constrained atomic-label interface and fixed eval_logic/tri_and/tri_not aggregation. Historical A2 reused old verbose caches, deterministic numeric processing and 17 compact repairs; all new atoms here use actual compact model generation. There are no numeric deterministic overrides.
evidence_note: Compact atomic interface does not generate evidence quotes. Do not interpret empty evidence as a failed quote-location diagnostic or a semantic model comparison of evidence quality.
